title: Associate
description:
The candidate will be responsible for drafting the patent applications across multiple technology domains, working closely with inventors, R&D teams, and patent attorneys to understand inventions and translate technical concepts into comprehensive patent specifications. The role will involve preparing provisional and complete patent specifications, claims, abstracts, and drawings in accordance with applicable patent laws and drafting standards.

The candidate will also assist in patent prosecution, responding to examination reports, conducting prior art and patentability searches, and supporting patent filings in India and international jurisdictions, including the United States, Europe, PCT, and Japan. Strong technical writing, analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret complex technical disclosures are essential for this role. Strong expertise in patent drafting, particularly preparation of patent specifications and claims Qualification: B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics/Telecommunication, Automobile, Production/Industrial, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Electrical

Key Skills: Prior art search,Patents,Patent Filing,Law,Searching,Patent search,Technical writing,Property
